hero.subtitle: EdTech • React Native
hero.title: Znaj.by
hero.tagline: Mobile app for schools in Belarus: electronic gradebook, grades, schedule, payments, and communication between teachers, parents, and students.

seo.title: Znaj.by — school app on React Native
seo.description: Electronic diary for schools: grades, schedules, payments, teacher-parent chat.

overview.title: About the project
overview.description: Znaj.by is a school platform that replaces paper diaries and manual processes. Three apps in one: for teachers, parents, and students. Listed in HolonIQ CIS EdTech 100 (2020).

solution.title: What was built
solution.description: Cross-platform React Native app (iOS + Android) with three user roles.

features.title: Electronic gradebook
features.description: Teachers enter grades and mark attendance. Parents see grades in real time. Students track schedules and assignments.

features.title: Communication
features.description: Direct messaging between teachers and parents. School announcements, event notifications.

features.title: School payments
features.description: Payment system integration for school-related expenses through the app.

impact.title: Outcome
impact.description: App published on the App Store and Google Play. Three roles: teachers, parents, students.

achievements.title: HolonIQ CIS EdTech 100
achievements.description: Ranked among top 100 EdTech companies in the CIS region in 2020

achievements.title: Three audiences in one app
achievements.description: Teachers, parents, and students — each with their own interface and feature set
